goat-processors runner · install card · release 0.6.0

Eight steps from Ubuntu 24.04 to a healthy runner

For a person at the machine. Each step: what to type, what you should see, what to do if you do not. The full guide, with every term explained, is /usr/share/doc/goat-processors/INSTALL.md once installed, and runner/INSTALL.md in the repository.

Have these first

ItemExampleAsk
Ubuntu Server 24.04 with an encrypted disk, reachable by SSH, a sudo loginops@10.20.0.15whoever installed the machine (goatcore OS baseline)
the fabric router and the site namerouter.site-a:7447, site-athe site's fabric administrator
three certificate files, PEMca.pem runner.pem runner.keythe site's certificate authority

Steps

#DoTypeYou should seeIf not
1Log in and check the systemssh ops@10.20.0.15
dpkg --print-architecture		amd64 or arm64other: not supported
2Get the five release files: .deb, .sigstore.json, install.sh, install-card.pdf, SHA256SUMSdownload from the releases page, tag runner-v0.6.0 (INSTALL.md step 2)five files in ~/goat-processorswithout internet: copy the five files over
3Check the checksums and the signaturesha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS
cosign verify-blob … (INSTALL.md step 3)		OK per file; Verified OKdo not install; download again
4Install the package and test itsudo apt install ./goat-processors_0.6.0_amd64.deb
goat-processors selftest		121 of 121 vectors … replay exactlysudo apt-get install -f; on FAIL lines, stop and report them
5Place the certificatessudo install -m 0640 -g goat-processors ca.pem runner.pem runner.key /etc/goat-processors/tls/three files, root goat-processors; then rm runner.keyrename to exactly these names
6Replace each word CHANGE-ME: site name; router name (keep tls/ and :7447)sudo nano /etc/goat-processors/runner.yaml
sudo goat-processors config check		validfix what it prints; certificate not named as the site: peer: its name
7Start the service, now and at every bootsudo systemctl enable --now goat-processorssystemctl is-active goat-processors prints activesudo journalctl -u goat-processors -n 30
8Wait five seconds, then ask doctorsudo goat-processors doctorlast line healthydo what each fix: line says, run doctor again

One command instead. In the release directory, install.sh does steps 1 to 8 and stops at the first problem with its fix. It is safe to run again:
sudo sh install.sh --site site-a --router router.site-a:7447 --ca ca.pem --cert runner.pem --key runner.key
